loadError: The dashboard could not load its configuration.
spotifyIntroText: You do not need to create or copy a token. The widget uses Spotify's official login and refreshes access automatically.
spotifyStep1Text: Open the official Developer Dashboard, choose Create app, and enable Web API when selecting APIs. A Spotify Premium account is required.
spotifyStep2Title: Add the Redirect URI and Client ID
spotifyStep2Text: Add this address exactly under Redirect URIs in the app settings. Do not use localhost.
clientIdLabel: CLIENT ID FROM THE APP SETTINGS
clientIdHint: Enter only the Client ID. A Client Secret is not required and should not be shared.
spotifyStep3Text: Spotify opens its own login window and requests read-only access to the currently playing track.
mainProfileHint: Main is the permanent default profile and cannot be renamed or deleted.
profileNameHint: The display name can be changed without changing the profile URL.
profileCreateHint: Up to five additional profiles are available. A new profile copies the selected design without copying its idle media file.
profileLimitReached: The limit of five additional profiles has been reached.
profileDeleteConfirm: Delete this profile and its locally stored idle media? This cannot be undone.
coverGlowHint: Subtly colors the title panel using a color from the cover without making it transparent.
rememberLastPlaybackHint: Keeps the last title, artist, cover, and progress while Spotify has no active item.
nothingPlayingTitleHint: Displayed as the title when no track is available.
nothingPlayingArtistHint: Displayed as the artist when no track is available.
nothingPlayingMediaHint: Optional local GIF, WebP, WebM, PNG, or JPEG up to 20 MB.
mediaUploadError: The file could not be stored. Check its format and the 20 MB size limit.
mediaRequiresCover: The idle media is stored, but it is visible only when the square cover is enabled.
showIdleMediaHint: Uses the uploaded file instead of the empty cover placeholder.
cropMediaHint: Uses a non-destructive crop that also works for animated media.
dimWhenIdleHint: Reduces the opacity of the complete widget when nothing is playing.
chromagicHint: Builds a coordinated, contrast-checked palette from the album artwork and changes panels in a gentle cascade. Manual color values stay saved.
widgetSurfaceOpacityHint: Adjusts widget surfaces. Album artwork and the official Spotify logo remain fully opaque.
widgetOutlineHint: Adds a configurable contour around widget panels.
widgetShadowHint: Adds a configurable shadow around widget panels.
automaticReadabilityHint: Chooses a high-contrast text color and shadow for the panel color. At low widget opacity, readability also depends on the OBS background.
textColorHint: Applies to metadata and time labels. Artist text remains slightly subdued.
textShadowHint: Adds a configurable shadow without changing the selected text color.
customProgressTrackColorHint: Off derives the unfilled track from the accent color. On uses the color below.
progressTrackColorHint: Sets the unfilled base. The accent still controls fill and visualizer.
hideOnPauseHint: Hides the widget while playback is paused.
songChangeOnlyHint: Shows the widget only after the track changes.
googleFontsStep1: Open Google Fonts and select a family.
googleFontsStep2: Copy the address from the browser address bar.
googleFontsStep3: Paste the address here; the family name is extracted automatically.
googleFontsInvalid: The URL does not contain a recognizable Google Font family.
googleFontsPrivacy: When this option is active, OBS requests the selected font directly from fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com. No font file is stored in this project.
bootstrapSourceHint: Use this local file URL when OBS may start before the server. It opens the generated bootstrap page and reconnects automatically.
sourceHint: The widget scales proportionally to the browser source and keeps at least 5% transparent safety space around the layout.
